display.name: DeepSeek Harness
display.description: Usage and health for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), from the @loongsuite/dsh-plugin OpenTelemetry export. Covers token spend and cache efficiency, turn and session volume, model latency and time to first token, native and MCP tool activity, and error breakdown. Token panels are scoped to gen_ai.span.kind = 'LLM' because the invoke_agent span repeats the same totals, so an unscoped sum double counts exactly 2x.

display.name: service_name
display.description: Service name reporting DeepSeek Harness telemetry

display.name: Agent Turns
display.description: One ENTRY span per turn. Subagent turns are included, because each subagent opens its own root span; the Activity chart breaks them out.

display.name: Sessions
display.description: Distinct dsh.session.id. A subagent runs under its own session id, linked to its parent by dsh.session.parent_id.

display.name: Model Calls
display.description: One chat span per model call.

display.name: Total Tokens
display.description: Scoped to LLM spans. The invoke_agent span repeats the same totals, so an unscoped sum double counts exactly 2x.

display.name: Cache Hit Rate
display.description: Read from AGENT spans on purpose: on LLM spans the cache attribute is absent rather than zero when nothing was cached, which biases the rate upward.

display.name: Token Usage Over Time
display.description: Input, cached and output tokens. Input and output come from LLM spans; cached reads come from AGENT spans, which always carry the cache fields.

display.name: Turn Outcomes
display.description: dsh.turn.end_reason on ENTRY spans: how turns actually finished.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND gen_ai.span.kind = 'ENTRY' AND dsh.turn.end_reason EXISTS

display.name: Activity Over Time
display.description: Turns, model calls, tool calls, and the subagent turns folded into the turn count.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND gen_ai.span.kind = 'ENTRY' AND dsh.session.origin = 'subagent'

display.name: Model Finish Reasons
display.description: LLM spans only. On AGENT spans this same attribute holds the turn outcome instead, so mixing the two produces a meaningless axis.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND gen_ai.span.kind = 'LLM' AND gen_ai.response.finish_reasons EXISTS

display.name: Model Call Latency
display.description: p95 and p99 duration of chat spans.

display.name: Token Distribution by Model
display.description: Total tokens per model, from LLM spans.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND gen_ai.span.kind = 'LLM' AND gen_ai.request.model EXISTS

display.name: Tool Call Distribution
display.description: Tools named mcp__<server>__<tool> come from an MCP server. No attribute distinguishes them, only the name.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND gen_ai.span.kind = 'TOOL' AND gen_ai.tool.name EXISTS

display.name: Errors Over Time
display.description: Reported tool errors count only tools that fail explicitly. A shell command exiting non-zero still records a successful span, so that line undercounts real tool failures.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND gen_ai.span.kind = 'ENTRY' AND dsh.turn.end_reason = 'error'
service.name IN $service_name AND gen_ai.span.kind = 'LLM' AND has_error = true
service.name IN $service_name AND gen_ai.span.kind = 'TOOL' AND error.type EXISTS

display.name: Session Details
display.description: Token spend and model calls per session. Subagent sessions appear as their own rows.

display.name: Tool Performance
display.description: Call count and latency per tool.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND gen_ai.span.kind = 'TOOL' AND gen_ai.tool.name EXISTS
